blocking: A saved 'playing' preference bypasses reduced-motion and Save-Data checks for automatic video loading on subsequent visits.
Without JavaScript, desktop celebration panels remain visually collapsed and their buttons cannot reveal the content.
The desktop accordion can clip its text in short landscape viewports because its height is viewport-capped and each panel hides overflow.

fixes.what: Always honor reduced motion and Save-Data on page load, regardless of a saved 'playing' preference. Allow video playback only after an explicit Play action on that page.
fixes.why: An earlier session preference should not silently override the visitor's current system or data settings.

fixes.where: assets/css/site.css — desktop accordion; assets/js/site.js — accordion initialization
fixes.what: Default to fully visible celebration cards. Apply collapsing styles and expose overlay buttons only after adding an accordion-ready class when handlers are installed.
fixes.why: Script failure currently leaves three descriptions invisible and the controls nonfunctional.

fixes.what: Replace the rigid desktop height cap with a content-safe minimum height; switch to stacked cards for short landscape viewports. Verify all four panels at 768×400 and with enlarged text.
fixes.why: Overflow hiding can cut off descriptions even when the page has no horizontal overflow.

fixes.what: Stop Lenis when Pause motion is selected, use immediate anchor scrolling while paused, and disable accordion expansion and hover movement transitions in that state. Restore them on Play when permitted.
fixes.why: The control promises to pause motion but currently leaves smooth scrolling and CSS movement active.

fixes.what: Change --red from #9E1B32 to the specified #D10C0C and check the logo SVG fills for consistency.
fixes.why: The implemented accent token differs from the supplied brand specification.
